positions.title: Jr. Software Developer C#/.NET Apprentice
positions.description:
The Software Guild was an apprenticeship program where the main focus was becoming a junior C#/.NET developer.
Developed an ASP.Net MVC application for a car dealership website.  Incorporated multiple web pages, images, user log-in, and internal links using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap.
Given a partially completed program & expected to understand what C#/.NET framework requirements were needed to finish the program to accomplish a fully functioning game of Battleship.
Built a program from the ground up using C#/.NET framework for a business flooring application that would take the users input & write it to a file, while being able to store and edit orders.
Utilized  HTML, CSS, Bootstrap & JavaScript to develop  a webpage designed around the functionality of a vending machine where the user can interact with it.
Developed the knowledge & understand of using Bitbucket,  Github, FishEye & Crucible to store projects & send documents to instructors.

positions.title: Guest Services Manager
positions.description:
Managed a staff of 8-10 Front Office/Guest Service  employees.
Worked over 40 hours per week to make sure guest’s stays were comfortable, up to their expectations, & made sure that the next time they stayed in town they would think of returning to the business. 
Created personal relationships with guests to plan for their future stays & anticipating any of their specific needs.
Involved in hiring & training over 30 employees & created  monthly schedules for the Front Office staff.
Followed a one-on-one scheduled monthly meeting with staff members to make sure they were up to date on hotel policies, new implementations, & what they expected from their job.
Created & implemented a concise daily workflow for staff members to follow.
Ordered & maintained inventory for the management staff, front office, sales department, & guest amenities with a spending amount of over $3,000 per month.
